---
title: "Soffritto"
description: The slow-cooked onion, carrot and celery base that a hundred other things start from.
categories: [component, base, vegan, batch-cook]
makes: soffritto
time: 45 min
servings: about 400 g
---

## Ingredients

- 4 tbsp olive oil
- 2 onions, finely diced
- 2 carrots, finely diced
- 3 sticks celery, finely diced
- 1 tsp salt

## Method

1. Dice everything to roughly the same small size. This matters more than knife skill — even pieces cook evenly.
2. Warm the oil in a heavy pan over low heat. Add the vegetables and the salt.
3. Cook very slowly for 40 minutes, stirring every few minutes. It should sigh, never sizzle hard.
4. It is done when the mixture has collapsed to about a third of its volume, turned deep gold, and smells sweet.

Freeze in 100 g blocks in an ice cube tray. Straight from frozen into a hot pan.
